title: 第377章 地府观影如懿传刀后革命3第376章 地府观影如懿传刀后革命2
content_zh:
【清成祖永琏：虽然生身之父我无从选择，但选阿玛的事情上，我还是费了不少精力，最后才选了承祜阿玛，他简直是天选之子，从年龄、长相、身份地位各个方面来说，他都是最合适的。】
？？？
这话一出，所有人不由一愣，四岁的承祜适合当阿玛？他们到底输在哪了呢？
胤俄拉着自家九哥的手，吐槽道：“还废了不少精力，我呸，从他造反到换阿玛，有一年吗？”
胤禟刚想讽刺老四一番，然而话还没出口，就听到了耳边的熟悉，却飘渺的声音。
“不入眼的人值得耗费精力吗？我赫舍里氏血脉尊贵，别说是一年、就是一天我都嫌多。”
这话一出，众人连忙回头望去，结果就看到了那个熟悉的人。
一如既往的桀骜不驯，整日里高高在上蔑视凡尘。
“太子二哥，您、您什么时候回来了？”
“吾乃赫舍里保成，母亲休了赘婿夫君，吾随母姓。”
！！！
康熙本来还在欣喜宝贝儿子的归来，结果这人刚回来就害自己丢脸，简直是不孝子！
“哈哈哈，康麻子，你儿子不要你了，妻子也不要你了，就连你阿玛顺治也不要你。你还不如我朱祁镇呢。”
“叫门太子，你侮辱谁呢？朕英明神武，一生文治武功不俗，岂是你个废物能比的？”
一心要在列祖列宗面前证明自己的朱祁镇见此，冷哼一声道：“哼，朱见深虽然不孝，但也不敢不认我，更何况我还有妻子钱氏和老爹的爱，你？啧啧，你不行。你都能自吹千古一帝，那我就是万古一帝！”
众人：......
要是这么比，那你确实赢了。
熄火提名的朱见深、朱瞻基更是忍不住捂住了脸，只觉得丢脸。
有这个傻缺老爹（儿子），自己真是造了孽啊！
感受着自家老爹杀人般的视线，朱棣身子一抖，连忙道：“爹，您放心，我回去就让瞻基给孙氏写休书，那个蠢货是孙祁镇，不是咱家。”

“哼，朱老四，算你识相！”
朱允炆：呜呜呜，四叔怎么这么鸡贼，我还没来得及上眼药呢。
【清成祖永琏：我努力从爱新觉罗家的族谱了扒了扒，大清开国至今，一共才五位皇帝，可供选择的人太少了，首先努尔哈赤、皇太极、顺治三人不配当我阿玛，踢出去。】
！！！
努尔哈赤、皇太极、顺治三人简直要气炸了，虽然他们也不愿意有人造谣自己，但自己不配？凭什么？
“玄烨，这就是你的后辈？肆意造谣、不懂孝道，你是怎么教导的？”
刚刚被朱祁镇气到自闭的康熙这会心情不爽，见罪魁祸首还敢质问自己，于是直接回道：“养子不教谁之过？我阿玛没教过我，我自然也不会教导孩子。”
“朕当年没教过你吗？你八岁之前在上书房......”
“你是我阿玛吗？你的第一子是荣亲王，我阿玛还不知道是谁呢。”
顺治：......回旋镖扎到了自己，该怎么办呢？
九子夺嫡的八龙对视一眼，皆在对方眼中看到了惊讶。
把老爷子气到自揭伤疤，朱祁镇这杀伤力可以啊！
“哈哈哈，又是一个不认爹的典范，野猪皮，你们老爱家的孝顺，可真是......”
content_en:
[Yonglian, Chengzu of the Qing Dynasty: Although I had no choice in choosing my biological father, I still put a lot of effort into choosing Amma, and finally I chose Chenghu Amma. He is simply the chosen one. In terms of age, appearance, and status, he is the most suitable. 】
? ? ?
As soon as these words came out, everyone couldn't help but be stunned. Four-year-old Chenghu is suitable to be Ama? Where did they lose?
Yiner held the hand of his ninth brother and complained: "A lot of energy was wasted. Damn it. From the time he rebelled to the time he changed to Ama, was there a year?"
Yinzhen was just about to make fun of the fourth child, but before he could say anything, he heard a familiar but ethereal voice in his ear.
"Is it worth spending energy on people who are not attractive to you? I have noble blood in the Hesheli family. Not to mention a year, even a day is too much for me."
As soon as these words came out, everyone quickly looked back and saw the familiar person.
As unruly as ever, he was aloof and contemptuous of the world all day long.
"Second Brother Prince, when did you come back?"
"I am Hesheli Baocheng. My mother divorced her husband, so I will take my mother's surname."
! ! !
Kangxi was still rejoicing at the return of his precious son, but as soon as this man came back, he embarrassed himself. He was simply an unfilial son!
"Hahaha, Kang Mazi, your son doesn't want you anymore, your wife doesn't want you anymore, and even your Ama Shunzhi doesn't want you. You are not as good as me, Zhu Qizhen."
"Who are you insulting when you call me Prince? I am wise and powerful, and I have excelled in both civil and martial arts throughout my life. How can I be compared to you, a loser?"
Zhu Qizhen, who was determined to prove himself in front of his ancestors, saw this and snorted coldly: "Huh, although Zhu Jianshen is unfilial, he dare not deny me, not to mention that I still have the love of my wife Qian and my father. You? Tsk, you can't. If you can boast of being the emperor of the ages, then I will be the emperor of the ages!"
Everyone:......
If this is the case, then you really win.
Zhu Jianshen and Zhu Zhanji, who had turned down their nominations, couldn't help but cover their faces, feeling embarrassed.
Having such a stupid father (son), I have really committed a sin!
Feeling his father's murderous gaze, Zhu Di shuddered and said quickly: "Dad, don't worry, I will ask Zhanji to write a letter of divorce to Sun when I get back. That idiot is Sun Qizhen, not our family."
"Hmph, Zhu Laosi, you are wise!"
Zhu Yunwen: Wow, oh, why is Fourth Uncle such a thief? I haven’t even had time to apply eye drops.
[Yonglian, the ancestor of the Qing Dynasty: I tried my best to pick up the genealogy of the Aixinjueluo family. Since the founding of the Qing Dynasty, there have been only five emperors in total. There are too few people to choose from. First of all, Nurhaci, Huang Taiji, and Shunzhi are not worthy of being my amma, so they should be kicked out. 】
! ! !
Nurhachi, Huang Taiji, and Shunzhi were about to explode with anger. Although they didn't want anyone to spread rumors about themselves, they didn't deserve it? Why?
"Xuan Ye, this is your descendant? He spreads rumors wantonly and doesn't understand filial piety. How do you teach him?"
Kangxi, who had just been so angry with Zhu Qizhen that he was autistic, was unhappy now. Seeing that the culprit dared to question himself, he directly replied: "Whose fault is it for not teaching an adopted son? My Ama has never taught me, so I naturally don't know how to teach children."
"Didn't I teach you back then? You were in the study room before you were eight years old..."
"Are you my Amma? Your first son is Prince Rong. My Amma doesn't know who he is yet."
Shunzhi: ...The boomerang pierced me, what should I do?
The nine sons and eight dragons looked at each other and saw surprise in each other's eyes.
If the old man is so angry that he exposes his own scars, Zhu Qizhen’s lethality can be so great!
"Hahaha, another example of not recognizing your father, Boar Skin, your filial piety towards your family is really..."
